caseName: Stevenson Iron Mining Co. v. Kibbe
caseNameFull: Stevenson Iron Mining Company, in Error v. Elmer A. Kibbe
summary: In error to the Circuit Court of the United States for the District of Minnesota.
attorneys: Mr. John G. Williams and Mr. Moses E. Clapp for plaintiff in error. Mr. Samuel A. Anderson for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs and interest. Minnesota Iron Company v. Kline, 199 U. S. 593; Holden v. Hardy, 169 U. S. 366, 392; Kibbe v. Stevenson Iron Company, 136 Fed. Rep. 147; Kline v. Minnesota Iron Company, 93 Minnesota, 63; Schus v. Powers-Simpson Company, 85 Minnesota, 447.
